version.title: ### `version` theme parameter
version.info: Version 5 uses the newer v5 theme composition mode, recommended for new themes. Also enables PNG support.

tcp_heights.title: ### `tcp_heights` theme parameter
tcp_heights.info: Default height of TCP panels: super-collapsed, small, medium, and full heights.

tcp_master_minheight.title: ### `tcp_master_minheight` theme parameter
tcp_master_minheight.info: Minimum height of the TCP master.

tcp_voltext_flags.title: ### `tcp_voltext_flags` theme parameter
tcp_voltext_flags.info:
Flags for volume strings.

1 = no dB

2 = no fractional precision

4 = no + on positive values

8 = always show two digits of precision

Optional second value specifies the maximum length of the total string.

tcp_vupeakwidth.title: ### `tcp_vupeakwidth` theme parameter
tcp_vupeakwidth.info: Size, in pixels, of the peak-hold indicator for the track panel meter.

mcp_vupeakheight.title: ### `mcp_vupeakheight` theme parameter
mcp_vupeakheight.info: Size, in pixels, of the peak-hold indicator for the mixer meter.

mcp_mastervupeakheight.title: ### `mcp_mastervupeakheight` theme parameter
mcp_mastervupeakheight.info: Size, in pixels, of the peak-hold indicator for the mixer master meter.

tcp_showborders.title: ### `tcp_showborders` theme parameter
tcp_showborders.info: Set to 0 to disable borders in the track panels.

mcp_showborders.title: ### `mcp_showborders` theme parameter
mcp_showborders.info: Set to 0 to disable borders in the mixer.

trans_showborders.title: ### `trans_showborders` theme parameter
trans_showborders.info: Set to 0 to disable borders in the transport.

mcp_altmeterpos.title: ### `mcp_altmeterpos` theme parameter
mcp_altmeterpos.info: Puts MCP meters on the right side.

tcp_vol_zeroline.title: ### `tcp_vol_zeroline` theme parameter
tcp_vol_zeroline.info: Sets the ABGR value of the TCP volume fader zero-line color. For example, `FFFF0000` produces solid blue. This was previously documented incorrectly.

item_volknobfg.title: ### `item_volknobfg` theme parameter
item_volknobfg.info:
Item volume knob colors.

`parm2`: zero-gain color

`parm3`: pushed color

no_meter_reclbl.title: ### `no_meter_reclbl` theme parameter
no_meter_reclbl.info: Hides the TCP meter record-input label.

warnings.title: ### `warnings` theme parameter
warnings.info:
Warning level: `all` or `pedantic`.

This is only used if the theme is not zipped.

misc_dpi_translate.title: ### `misc_dpi_translate` theme parameter
misc_dpi_translate.info: Affects elements such as toolbar images. The theme can specify one or more of these lines. If the DPI scaling is higher than `src_scale_percent`, `dest_scale_percent` is used. For example, `misc_dpi_translate 126 150` ensures that 1.5× images are used when the DPI is above 126%.

global_scale.title: ### `global_scale` theme parameter
global_scale.info: Specifies the inherent DPI scaling of the theme. For example, if the theme uses only HiDPI images, setting this to 2.0 prevents a 2× display from scaling those images up further.

layout_dpi_translate.title: ### `layout_dpi_translate` theme parameter
layout_dpi_translate.info:
Remaps layouts by DPI. If the DPI is greater than `min_scale` (where 1.0 = 100%, 1.5 = 150%, etc.), and the user selects `requested_layout_name`, `destination_layout_name` is used instead.

An empty `requested_layout_name` can be used to match the default layout.
